newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade, dealers said on Tuesday.

They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. February wholesale inventories data, which is forecast to show a gain of 0.4 percent compared with a one percent increase reported in January.

"Rates were quietly steady in the morning on some position adjustments amid uncertainty over direction. Some people are waiting for tonight's wholesale inventories figures for February," a local dealer said.
"But unless the numbers are way off market expectations, I don't think there will be much impact here," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday, Wednesday/Thursday and week-fixed were unchanged from Monday's common 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, six-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-5/16 6-3/16 percent.
